description: duo CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record): the stack this plugin's own tests run in. Installs the depends_on closure (identity_core, the vocabulary dependency behind HELD_BY_HUMAN__identity_core, from git at a pinned commit) and duo; the consumer flips self to editable so the checkout under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population seeds duo's own GRIFT (the /duo page bundle), which proves the bundle parses and its panel type resolves against a real registry. Installation fetches the two pinned git sources; nothing after installation reaches the network, and no credential is used. Deliberately excluded: every plugin outside the depends_on closure.

plugins.note: Vocabulary dependency, pinned at the main commit carrying identity_core__human and HELD_BY_HUMAN__identity_core (no tagged release carries them yet; v0.1.2 predates both). Offline and credential-free.

Self, pinned at the bootstrap commit until the first tagged release; the consumer (plugin-ci, or `spawn --dev-plugins duo`) substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4).

steps.note: Own GRIFT: the /duo page, its panels, searches and account-map layout. No instance data.
